```{r setup}
# Short report from a pipeline run. Reads the files written by the pipeline to
# <results_dir>/<run_name>/ and renders GitHub-flavoured markdown. PDFs from the
# pipeline are converted to PNG in report/figures/ (needs the pdftools package).
# Sections whose output file is missing are skipped.
#
#   quarto render report/dnam_report.qmd --to gfm \
#     -P results_dir:results -P run_name:test
#   Rscript report/export_to_site.R ../aggarwal-ayush.github.io

# Quarto runs this file from report/, so relative results_dir values are
# resolved against the project root (..); absolute paths are used as given.
is_abs <- grepl("^(/|~|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", params$results_dir)
res_root <- if (is_abs) params$results_dir else file.path("..", params$results_dir)
res_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(res_root, params$run_name), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(res_dir)) stop("Results folder not found: ", res_dir, call. = FALSE)
f <- function(suffix) file.path(res_dir, paste0(params$run_name, "__", suffix))
fig_dir <- "figures"
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

read_if <- function(path) if (file.exists(path)) utils::read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE, tryLogical = F) else NULL

# Convert page `pages` of a pipeline PDF to PNG; returns markdown image links
pdf_to_png <- function(pdf, stem, pages = NULL) {
  if (!file.exists(pdf)) return(character())
  if (!requireNamespace("pdftools", quietly = TRUE)) {
    warning("pdftools not installed; skipping ", basename(pdf))
    return(character())
  }
  n <- pdftools::pdf_info(pdf)$pages
  pages <- if (is.null(pages)) seq_len(n) else intersect(pages, seq_len(n))
  out <- file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("%s-%d.png", stem, pages))
  pdftools::pdf_convert(pdf, pages = pages, filenames = out, dpi = params$fig_dpi, verbose = FALSE)
  sprintf("![](%s)", out)
}

show_images <- function(md) if (length(md)) cat(md, sep = "\n\n")
show_table <- function(df, n = Inf, ...) {
  if (is.null(df)) return(invisible())
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(df, n), ...))
}

qc <- read_if(f("sesame-qc_flagged.csv"))
```

## Overview

This report summarises a run of the DNA methylation pipeline (`r params$run_name`) on a small set of
public Illumina 450K arrays. The pipeline processes IDATs with sesame, runs QC, calls
copy-number alterations with conumee2, classifies samples, and finds differentially
methylated regions with DMRcate.

```{r qc-table, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(qc)) {
  cat("## Sample QC\n\n")
  cat(nrow(qc), "samples were processed. Flagged samples are marked in the table.\n\n")
  keep <- intersect(c("sample", "Sample_ID", "frac_dt_mk", "mean_intensity_MU", "RGdistort",
                      "infered_sex", "any_flag", "flag_reason"), names(qc))
  show_table(qc[, if (length(keep)) keep else names(qc), drop = FALSE], digits = 3)
}
```

```{r snp, results='asis'}
img <- pdf_to_png(f("sesame-qc_snp-heatmap.pdf"), "snp-heatmap")
if (length(img)) {
  cat("\n\n### SNP-probe heatmap\n\n",
      "Samples from the same individual should cluster together.\n\n")
  show_images(img)
}
```

```{r survey, results='asis'}
img <- pdf_to_png(f("dmr-qc_density-mds.pdf"), "density-mds")
if (length(img)) {
  cat("\n\n## Beta-value distributions and MDS\n\n",
      "Density plots (by group and by sample) and an MDS plot of the cleaned beta values ",
      "after detection p-value, SNP, cross-hybridising and replicate-probe filtering.\n\n")
  show_images(img)
}
```

```{r cna, results='asis'}
seg <- read_if(f("conumee2_cna-segments.csv"))
summ <- list.files(res_dir, pattern = "conumee2_summary-plot.*\\.pdf$", full.names = TRUE)
if (!is.null(seg) || length(summ)) cat("\n\n## Copy-number alterations\n\n")
if (length(summ)) show_images(pdf_to_png(summ[1], "cna-summary"))
if (!is.null(seg)) {
  cat("\n\nNumber of CNA segments per sample:\n\n")
  id_col <- intersect(c("ID", "sample", "Sample_ID"), names(seg))[1]
  if (!is.na(id_col)) show_table(as.data.frame(table(Sample = seg[[id_col]])), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r classifier, results='asis'}
cl <- read_if(f("meningioma_classification.csv"))
if (!is.null(cl)) {
  cat("\n\n## Methylation classifier\n\n")
  show_table(cl, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r dmr, results='asis'}
dmr <- read_if(f("dmrcate_dmrs.csv"))
if (is.null(dmr)) {
  alt <- list.files(res_dir, pattern = "dmrcate_dmrs.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  dmr <- if (length(alt)) do.call(rbind, lapply(alt, utils::read.csv, check.names = FALSE)) else NULL
}
cat("\n\n## Differentially methylated regions (DMRcate)\n\n")
if (is.null(dmr)) {
  cat("No DMRs were called for this run (for example, too few samples per group).\n\n")
} else {
  cat(nrow(dmr), "DMRs were called. Top", min(params$top_n_dmrs, nrow(dmr)),
      "by minimum smoothed FDR:\n\n")
  ord <- if ("min_smoothed_fdr" %in% names(dmr)) order(dmr$min_smoothed_fdr) else seq_len(nrow(dmr))
  keep <- intersect(c("contrast", "seqnames", "start", "end", "width", "no.cpgs",
                      "min_smoothed_fdr", "meandiff", "overlapping.genes"), names(dmr))
  show_table(dmr[ord, keep, drop = FALSE], n = params$top_n_dmrs, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
  show_images(pdf_to_png(f("dmrcate_dmr-plots.pdf"), "dmr-top", pages = 1))
}
```

```{r heatmaps, results='asis'}
img <- pdf_to_png(f("differential-methylation_heatmaps.pdf"), "diff-heatmap")
if (length(img)) {
  cat("\n\n## Differential methylation heatmaps\n\n",
      "Beta values for the top probes per condition, probes with P <= 0.05 and probes with ",
      "adjusted P <= 0.05. Columns are annotated by condition and rows by the condition with ",
      "higher methylation.\n\n")
  show_images(img)
}
```
